name: Moral Orel
description: Orel is an 11-year-old boy who loves church. His unbridled enthusiasm for piousness and his misinterpretation of religious morals often lead to disastrous results, including self-mutilation and crack addiction. No matter how much trouble he gets into, his reverence always keeps him cheery.

credits_cast.character: Coach Stopframe / Miss Censordoll / Sal Figurelli (voice)
credits_cast.name: Jay Johnston

videos.title: Making Moral Orel
videos.overview: A Behind the scenes look at the show Moral Orel. (This is a vol. 1 dvd special feature)

videos.title: Beforel Orel
videos.overview: A Moral Orel special that sheds light on the origin of Orel's religious nature and the birth of his brother, Shapey.

videos.title: Abstinence
videos.overview: Doughy finds his true calling and becomes a professional "Cock-Blocker".

videos.title: Rev. Putty Sermons: Cuteness
videos.overview: The good reverend hates babies. Who would have thought?

videos.title: Rev. Putty Sermons: Gay Guys
videos.overview: A sermon about having a good Christian work ethic evolves into a homophobic tirade.

videos.title: Rev. Putty Sermons: Laziness
videos.overview: Reverend Putty tries to give a sermon teaching us how idle hands are the devil's play things, but gets sidetracked.

videos.title: Rev. Putty Sermons: Necrophilia
videos.overview: Putty has some unconventional ideas of death.

videos.title: Rev. Putty Sermons: Old Age
videos.overview: Reverend Putty's afraid of getting old.

videos.title: The Awkward Comic-Con Panel
videos.overview: Panel filmed at Comic-Con San Diego

videos.title: The Best Christmas Ever
videos.overview: After Reverend Putty teaches Orel that Jesus will one day return to the earth, he believes that his younger brother, Shapey, is the second coming of Christ. Orel's parents plan for their divorce, and Christmas looks set to be an unhappy one.

videos.title: The Lord's Greatest Gift
videos.overview: After learning that God's greatest gift is life, Orel recruits his friend Doughy to help protect that gift. A library book, a graveyard full of dead townsfolk, and Orel's convictions spell trouble for the population of Moralton.

videos.title: Waste
videos.overview: Orel Puppington learns that God doesn't look kindly on the wasteful. After lessons from Coach Stopframe and his father, he sets out with two goals in mind. Orel must stop his own wastefulness, and ensure he doesn't end up the failure his father predicts of him. Will he succeed, or will he upset the townsfolk once again?

videos.title: Charity
videos.overview: After Orel is taught that the Christian way is to help the poor, he befriends a homeless crack dealer. The homeless man offers a gift in return, and well - it just wouldn't be polite to refuse. Good Christians aren't wasteful either, and Orel does his fair share to ensure the town's crack supply doesn't go to waste.

videos.title: Omnipresence
videos.overview: Orel learns that God is present in everyone and everything. He ends up excusing himself from school, and going on a trip across town believing that he is able to stop people from sinning and heal them.

videos.title: The Blessed Union
videos.overview: Orel learns that people should do everything they can to keep their wives happy. He goes around town and asks women including his mother, what they want.

videos.title: God-Fearing
videos.overview: Halloween is boring for Orel when he believes that he doesn't have anything to fear since God is with him at all times. Hoping to get scared, Orel decides to make God angry with him by breaking all 10 Commandments.

videos.title: Maturity
videos.overview: After getting shot in the eye with Shapey's BB gun, Orel's father tells him to be more repsonsible and mature. In order to learn more about maturity, Orel goes to the local pub and drinks alcohol which is known to him as "Maturity Juice".

videos.title: Loyalty
videos.overview: After running into Orel at church, Coach Stopframe asks if Orel would become Bible Buddies with his nephew Joe, who isn't settled into christianity yet. Despite Joe doing bad things for fun, Orel believes that it he should be a loyal friend and go along with it.

videos.title: God's Chef
videos.overview: In order to masturbate and still go to heaven, Orel has a scheme that turns Moralton topsy-turvy

videos.title: God's Image
videos.overview: When the young Italian Figurelli boy, Billy, gets hurt, Orel tries to put a band-aid on him with the same color as God's skin but the band-aid doesn't blend in with Billy's skin color. However, the band-aid's blend in with other kid's skins just fine. This leads Orel to prompt the city of Moralton to segregate God's people from the Figurelli's, the only Italian-American family in the town. But this, however leads to a form of reverse racism. Soon the Figurelli's special treatment gets too out of hand for the other citizens of Moralton & they begin to go on a rampage! Now it's up to Orel's Father to set things right.

videos.title: Love
videos.overview: Orel befriends a stray dog and Bloberta allows Orel to keep it. After a while, the two grow very attached and Orel becomes worried that he's loving his dog Bartholomew more than Jesus. Bartholomew quickly spreads enough love around Moralton that convinces the adults that he is a danger.

videos.title: Satan
videos.overview: Coach Stopframe goes to a meeting of a Satanic cult, taking Orel with him. However, Coach Stopframe is turned off from the cult when he sees that everyone in the meeting is overweight, wandering around in the nude, and devouring junk food refreshments.

videos.title: Elemental Orel
videos.overview: Orel solves problems using logic. After the money from collection at church is stolen, he sets out to find out who took the money, only to discover a bigger mystery involving his mother.

videos.title: Offensiveness
videos.overview: Miss Censordoll takes Orel under her wing.

videos.title: God's Blunders
videos.overview: Orel's friend, Tommy, is placed in the 'Special Retarded Education' program.

videos.title: Pleasure
videos.overview: After listening to Reverand Putty's sermon, Orel realises that pleasure is not righteous and starts to avoid it. Soon after, he then finds pain to be an alternative.

videos.title: The Lord's Prayer
videos.overview: A new family, the Posabule's, move in next door to the Puppingtons, and Orel becomes infactuated with their daughter, Christina. However, after a little altercation between the families, he is banned from seeing her.

videos.title: Holy Visage
videos.overview: Orel learns about the significance of religious symbolism. In an accident, Dr. Chosenberg gets an image of Jesus in a wound. Nobody from the town wants to treat it because they see it as a sign from Heaven.

videos.title: Be Fruitful and Multiply
videos.overview: After spending many nights alone, Reverend Putty sets his sights on Stephanie, but how will things work out between them?

videos.title: Praying
videos.overview: Orel is chosen by Principal Fakey to represent Diorama Elementary in the Praying Bee competition. Stressing out and unable to pray, Orel finds himself turning to the Buddhist method of meditation.

videos.title: Repression
videos.overview: After learning that Principal Fakey is doing something wrong, Orel goes to his father to find out about wrong-doing authority figures. There, he learns that repression is the antidote to everything.

videos.title: Turn the Other Cheek
videos.overview: After listening to a record by Presbo the Clown about turning the other cheek, Orel continually allows himself to be beaten up by Walt, the school bully.

videos.title: Geniusis
videos.overview: During a Pious Scouts camping trip, Orel discovers man's missing link and then learns the meaning of Geniusis; the worded combination about the genius of the Bible's Genesis story.

videos.title: Courtship
videos.overview: Doughy becomes infatuated with Miss Sculptham when she is only using him to gain gifts. Meanwhile, Orel learns a valuable lesson about man and woman relationships.

videos.title: School Pageant
videos.overview: Orel tries out for the lead role in the School Pageant, however he has some stiff competition.

videos.title: Presents for God
videos.overview: Reverend Putty realises that there are no sinners left in Moralton, and begins to feel lost. Orel, wanting to help, imports a number of new lost souls from the neighbouring town for Reverend Putty to save.

videos.title: Orel's Movie Premiere
videos.overview: Orel holds a premiere of his new stop-motion animated film in his back yard for a number of the leading authority figures of Moralton.

videos.title: Nature (1)
videos.overview: Clay takes his son, Orel, on a camping trip.

videos.title: Nature (2)
videos.overview: Clay and Orel continue their father and son hunting trip.

videos.title: Numb
videos.overview: Bloberta searches for a solution to her humdrum life.

videos.title: Grounded
videos.overview: It's finally the last straw when Clay grounds Orel from church.

videos.title: Innocence
videos.overview: The town gets together and agrees not to give Orel any more advice.

videos.title: Alone
videos.overview: While Orel is on the hunting trip, the lives of Ms. Sculptham, Ms. Censordoll and Nurse Bendy are shown in disturbing detail.

videos.title: Trigger
videos.overview: When Doughy becomes Orel's shooting coach, he discovers that his student has quite the "itchy trigger finger."

videos.title: Dumb
videos.overview: Discontent with being raised by his octogenarian Father and depressed, middle-aged half sister, Joe searches for a more vibrant guardian.

videos.title: Help
videos.overview: Bloberta ponders Orel's question: "Why did you marry Dad?"

videos.title: Passing
videos.overview: Clay considers the tradition of passing Ol' Gunny down from generation to generation.

videos.title: Closeface
videos.overview: Stephanie is hell-bent on Orel having a better experience than her own at the school's annual "Arms Length Dance."

videos.title: Sundays
videos.overview: A year's worth of the most important weekday in Moralton is explored through the eyes of some very very minor characters.

videos.title: Sacrifice
videos.overview: It's Easter and the lack of happiness in Moralton leads several troubled souls to Forghetty's Pub for some unavailable solace.

videos.title: Nesting
videos.overview: Miss Censordoll slowly hatches a plan to make eggs legal again.

videos.title: Honor
videos.overview: Orel needs to discover something to honor his father about and finds it in Coach Stopframe.

awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 2 wins & 6 nominations total
